question: Is the DODO 2021 "Cheetah" (EOA 0x8a14ce0f via proxy 0xa57bd001), the Earning.Farm 2022 bot (EOA 0x26bce6ec -> contract 0xa69babef, owner wallet 0x56178a0d) and the anonymous-sender profiles "0xa57 family" one operator?
verdict: YES - one operator (high confidence, not proof of identity). It is a large general MEV/arbitrage operation running a fleet of hundreds of EOAs (wards) through a family of auth-proxy contracts and rotating executors; it is not an exploit-hunter. Cheetah and the EF bot are two EOAs/eras of the same deployment.

evidence.fact: 0x8641df2d deployed 0xa57bd001 (2019-03-26, tx 0x0d8fc644..) AND 0x95a64fc0 (2022-06-24) which created 0xa69babef (2022-08-15, tx 0x4d373b2c..). 0xa69babef exposes every selector of 0xa57bd001 plus batch-rely/deny and a callback.

Cheetah's DODO tx 0x75d4765d.. (block 12000167): 1,139,456.204396 USDT moved bypass contract 0x910fd17b -> executor 0x3a518964 -> 0x56178a0d. 0x56178a0d is the capital wallet that lent 14,707.09 WETH (got 15,187.10 back) in the Earning.Farm tx 0x1f1aba5b.. (block 15746200).

0x56178a0d itself deployed executor 0x3a518964 (2021-02-16) and EF helper 0x0e113904 (2022-08-22), both through the executor factory 0xf3c9d00c; both share the interface 0x1cff79cd/0x80d6c5a1/0xec556889.

Executor factory 0xf3c9d00c was created by 0x8641df2d in 2019-01. All 30 top executors of 0xa57bd001 (100% of the 458,903 execute() calls in the complete 2019-03..2020-08 scan) came from it, deployed by wards of the proxy (0xc6093fd9, 0x97c54b98, 0xcedb4f8d, 0xef08524e, 0x00e34a4e, 0x9787ffbd, 0xc39eaabe, 0x8641df2d, 0x519b9ef6).

Ward set: 8641df2d (79 calls) and 0x97c54b98 (200 calls) relied 279 distinct EOAs by 2019-11 (581 rely calls through 2020-08). 568 distinct callers by 2020-08; ~370 of the 378 callers seen in 30 sampled a69babef pages also called 0xa57bd001.

Cheetah EOA 0x8a14ce0f first funded by ward 0xc6093fd9 (2020-05-12, tx 0x2cd7a97c..); EF EOA 0x26bce6ec first funded by ward 0x97c54b98 (2019-11-10). Both are topped up by the same wallet 0x9787ffbd (38x and 145x) and by hub 0x8641df2d. 0x8a14ce0f sent 62,464 txs to 0xa69babef and 0x26bce6ec 166k: both EOAs drive the EF contract.
Migration: 0xa57bd001 traffic stops around 2023-03-13 (last bulk), while every fleet EOA starts calling 0xa69babef on 2022-08-22, a week after its creation (blk 15346875).

The 0xa57 proxy and the EF contract are NOT the same bytecode (3,135 B vs 11,793 B): "implementation upgrade" happens at two levels: (a) executor rotation behind the proxy (30+ delegate targets 2019-2022; see executors), (b) proxy replacement by a larger superset (2022-08).

caveats: Same operator != named identity; no label for the owner of 0x56178a0d/0x8641df2d was sought.

Etherscan txlist is complete for hubs/EOAs; 0xa57bd001 txlist is complete through block 10.59M (2020-08-04, 459,495 txs) then sampled (1,000 consecutive txs every 250k blocks to block 16.96M, plus the newest 2,000); a69babef sampled every 300k blocks. Counts after 2020-08 are estimates from sample density.
Slim 0xa57bd001 rows through 2020-08 are in scratch (not saved raw to avoid GBs); raw pages up to block 9.71M and the sample pages are in site/raw/etherscan/w8_*.

w2_scan_family_txs_near_exploits.note: research/chain-scan (394 DHL attack txs, blocks B-2..B+1) traced 98 txs by the family contracts (79 via 0xa69babef, 15 via 0xa57bd001, others 4cb18386/fa103c21/9799b475). NONE has an argument-level replay (all flagged no_argument_match = post-hack arb/ordinary flow) except EFVault 2022-10-14 (and 2023-02-24 shows two a69babef txs one block before the DHL attack: score -1). Large coinbase payers listed below are probably post-hack arbitrage, not captures.

incidents.not_covered: No full-history exploit-replay sweep of the millions of proxy txs was possible (no per-tx traces); only the chain scan +-2-block windows around 394 DHL attack txs and the two known incidents. Absence of other replays is therefore "not found", not "none".

dodo_2021.evidence: tokentx: 1,139,456.204396 USDT sent 56178a0d -> 0xfa103c21 -> DODO pool 0x95c4f5b83aa70810d4f142d58e5f7242bd891cb0 in tx 0x6e743db045f3738b24c6dedc90bae62c6429f2f7fe8a086394b05a68b8f5867a (block 12004002, 2021-03-09 11:18 UTC; the stolen amount to the wei, 14.3 h after the take); the pool paid it out to 0x96627558c6.. at 16:34 (tx 0x7a694d3624..). The Block reported "Individual A" returned ~1.14M USDT + 411 ETH (https://www.theblock.co/post/97734/dodo-dex-exploit-bug-attack). The 411 ETH leg and the 133,548.94 wCRES leg were not located on-chain.

earningfarm_2022.evidence: capital wallet got 15,187.097 WETH back vs 14,707.089 borrowed (+480.008); 18.717 ETH paid to builder; no transfer to the vault or any public statement found (incidents/earningfarm-2022).

returns_vs_keeps.pattern: The operator returned only where it was publicly asked and the owner could be identified (DODO had two recoverers, a whitehat go-between); no return evidence in the EF case. Not a consistent "returns hack funds" policy.
